caption:
The 8 truths about your boring closet.

Your body is fine. Your face is fine. Your closet is the problem. Boring clothes mean you're telling the world you gave up. That's not humility. That's invisibility.

This guide teaches you how to weaponize your wardrobe. One striking element per outfit. That's the entire discipline.
